# CONTINUATION SUMMARY

## 1. Outstanding User Requests
- **Implement M4 - PENDAFTARAN KLUB (Club Registration Module)**
  - **Status**: `IMPLEMENTATION`
  - **User Request**: 
    > "buatkan M4 - PENDAFTARAN KLUB
    > 📋 DESKRIPSI UMUM: Modul Pendaftaran Klub adalah sistem untuk mengelola pendaftaran klub baru ke dalam MB INA. Proses ini mencakup pengajuan formulir, verifikasi data, dan aktivasi klub.
    > 🗂️ STRUKTUR M4: 4.1 Formulir Pendaftaran (4.1.1 Data Klub, 4.1.2 Upload Dokumen, 4.1.3 Preview & Submit), 4.2 Daftar Pending (4.2.1 List Pengajuan, 4.2.2 Status Tracking), 4.3 Detail Pengajuan (4.3.1 Review Data, 4.3.2 Approve/Reject, 4.3.3 Catatan Internal), 4.4 Klub Aktif (4.4.1 List Klub Aktif, 4.4.2 Status Klub, 4.4.3 Evaluasi Kinerja)"
  - **Current Progress**:
    - Migration script (`scratch/migrate_m4_tables.php`) created and executed on Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL.
    - Database tables `club_applications`, `club_application_notes`, `club_status_history`, `club_evaluations` created, and `clubs` altered with M4 columns. Sample data seeded.
    - API endpoints (`get_m4_data`, `submit_club_application`, `update_club_application_status`, `add_club_application_note`, `save_club_evaluation`) added to `api.php` and verified.
    - `get_app_init_data` in `api.php` updated to batch-load M4 data.
    - Admin tab button (`📝 M4 - Pendaftaran Klub`) and M4 main container HTML (`admin-tab-m4_registration`) added to [index.html](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/index.html).
    - **Next Step**: Add JavaScript functions in [js/app.js](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/js/app.js) to render subtabs 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, control the multi-step form wizard, process approval/rejection modal, and handle performance evaluation.

---

## 2. User Knowledge
- **User Directives & Quotes**:
  - *"sianjing.....sisanya dimakan RAYAP???"* -> Demand to populate all 18 executive cabinet positions in `organization_structure` table in Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL.
  - *"email numpuk, Member Id jadi ke bawah. tombol aksi kalo bikin sesak, tampilkan icon saja gak usah diberi teks"* -> Demand to format table cells so Member ID doesn't break to 2 lines and replace text buttons with compact icon-only buttons.
  - *"pake ruler horizintal, bikin cape admin..."* -> Strictly enforce 100% viewport width table layout with ZERO horizontal scrollbars (`white-space: nowrap` + compact column layout).
  - *"hidupin servernya"* -> Restart PHP built-in server on `localhost:8000`.
  - *"buatkan M4 - PENDAFTARAN KLUB..."* -> Specifications for Module 4 (Tables, SQL Schema, Multi-step wizard, Pending list & tracking, Detail review & notes, Active clubs & evaluation).

---

## 3. Work Accomplished
1. **Seeded 18 Cabinet Positions in Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL**:
   - Executed `scratch/seed_full_cabinet_structure.php` to populate all 18 official executive cabinet roles into `organization_structure`.

2. **Fixed M3 Member Table Layout (Zero Horizontal Scrollbar)**:
   - Restructured M3 Member List table into 6 compact columns in [js/app.js](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/js/app.js).
   - Combined Name + Email + Phone vertically; Tier + Status vertically; and turned Action buttons into 30x30px square icons (`👁️`, `✏️`, `💰`, `🗑️`).

3. **Server Management**:
   - Launched background PHP server daemon on `localhost:8000` via task `task-1316` (`HTTP 200 OK`).

4. **Created M4 Database Schema in Supabase Cloud**:
   - Executed `scratch/migrate_m4_tables.php`.
   - Created `club_applications`, `club_application_notes`, `club_status_history`, `club_evaluations`, altered `clubs` table, and seeded initial applications.

5. **Implemented M4 Backend API Endpoints in [api.php](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/api.php)**:
   - Added `get_m4_data`, `submit_club_application`, `update_club_application_status`, `add_club_application_note`, `save_club_evaluation`.
   - Updated `get_app_init_data` batch query to return `clubApplications`, `clubApplicationNotes`, `clubEvaluations`.

6. **Added M4 View HTML Structure in [index.html](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/index.html)**:
   - Added `data-admin-tab="m4_registration"` button in `.admin-tab-bar`.
   - Added `#admin-tab-m4_registration` with subtabs `4.1 Formulir Pendaftaran` (Step 1, Step 2, Step 3), `4.2 Daftar Pending & Status`, `4.3 Detail Review Pengajuan`, `4.4 Klub Aktif & Evaluasi`.

---

## 4. Model Knowledge
- **Supabase Cloud M4 Schema**:
  - `club_applications`: `id`, `organization_id`, `name`, `code`, `alias`, `province_id`, `province_name`, `city`, `address`, `founded_year`, `member_count_estimate`, `club_type`, `description`, `contact_person`, `contact_phone`, `contact_email`, `social_media` (JSONB), `logo_url`, `photos` (JSONB), `status` ('DRAFT','PENDING','REVIEW','APPROVED','REJECTED'), `rejection_reason`, `submitted_by`, `submitted_at`, `reviewed_by`, `reviewed_at`, `approved_by`, `approved_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.
  - `club_application_notes`: `id`, `application_id`, `user_id`, `user_name`, `note`, `is_internal`, `created_at`.
  - `clubs` (updated): `application_id`, `status`, `verified_at`, `verified_by`, `last_evaluation`, `evaluation_score`.
  - `club_status_history`: `id`, `club_id`, `old_status`, `new_status`, `reason`, `changed_by`, `created_at`.
  - `club_evaluations`: `id`, `club_id`, `evaluation_date`, `score`, `category`, `notes`, `evaluator`, `evaluator_name`, `created_at`.

---

## 5. Files and Code

### Edited Files
- [api.php](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/api.php):
  - Updated `get_app_init_data` to include M4 tables.
  - Added case handlers for `get_m4_data`, `submit_club_application`, `update_club_application_status`, `add_club_application_note`, `save_club_evaluation`.
- [index.html](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/index.html):
  - Added M4 tab button to `.admin-tab-bar`.
  - Added `#admin-tab-m4_registration` DOM structure with 4 subtabs and multi-step registration form wizard.
- [js/app.js](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/js/app.js):
  - Fixed M3 member table layout to 6 compact columns with zero horizontal scrollbar and icon-only action buttons.
- [scratch/migrate_m4_tables.php](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/scratch/migrate_m4_tables.php):
  - Migration script for M4 database tables.
- [scratch/seed_full_cabinet_structure.php](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/scratch/seed_full_cabinet_structure.php):
  - Seeded 18 executive cabinet positions into `organization_structure`.

---

## 6. Current Work and Next Steps
- **Immediate Task**: Complete JavaScript logic in [js/app.js](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/js/app.js) for Module 4:
  1. Add `m4Data` state object in `AppEngine` (`m4Data: { activeSubtab: 'form', step: 1, applications: [], notes: [], evaluations: [] }`).
  2. Implement `switchM4Subtab(subtab)` and `goToM4Step(step)`.
  3. Implement `renderM4PendingList()`, `renderM4DetailReview(appId)`, `renderM4ActiveClubs()`.
  4. Implement handlers for `handleM4FormSubmit()`, `openM4ReviewModal()`, `submitM4ApproveReject()`, `addM4InternalNote()`, and `openM4EvaluationModal()`.
  5. Add M4 Modals to [index.html](file:///c:/xampp/htdocs/MBCINA/index.html) if required or render them dynamically.
- **Server Status**: PHP local server is running on `http://localhost:8000` (task `task-1316`).
